attributes.board_name: Wisconsin Marriage and Family Therapy, Professional Counseling, and Social Work Examining Board (DSPS)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs offered or approved by national and state social work, counseling, marriage and family therapy, rehabilitation counseling and addiction counseling organizations; accredited colleges and universities; AMA/AOA CME; employer in-house training (max 15 hours unless approved by a listed organization). Credit also for presenting or developing CE, teaching college courses, authoring textbooks, chapters, articles or media. DSPS does not pre-approve courses.
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE is required for the first license renewal.

topics.who: Ethics and professional boundaries related to the area of practice
Part of the 4-hour ethics and professional boundaries requirement

rules.notes: Reporting period runs March 1 of an odd year to February 28/29 of the next odd year.
